title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Configurable Prototype Ruleset
disclaimer: Prototype screening aid only. Not legal advice or a definitive compliance determination. Final enforcement requires an authorized Legal Metrology officer.
based_on: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — common mandatory declarations (prototype mapping)

rules.name: Commodity / Product Name
rules.requirement: Name of the commodity should be clearly declared on the package.
rules.validation_logic: PASS if extracted; FAIL/NOT_DETECTED if missing; WARNING if low confidence.
rules.fail_message: Product / commodity name was not detected from the label image.
rules.fail_recommendation: Ensure the commodity name is prominently printed and clearly visible in the photo.
rules.warning_message: Product name detection confidence is low.
rules.warning_recommendation: Manually verify the commodity name on the principal display panel.

rules.name: MRP Declaration
rules.requirement: Maximum Retail Price (inclusive of all taxes) should be declared.
rules.validation_logic: PASS if MRP value detected; FAIL/NOT_DETECTED otherwise.
rules.fail_recommendation: Ensure MRP is printed as 'MRP Rs. … (inclusive of all taxes)' or equivalent and is readable in the image.
rules.warning_message: MRP-related text may be incomplete or low-confidence.
rules.warning_recommendation: Verify MRP value, currency and tax-inclusive wording manually.

rules.name: Net Quantity Declaration
rules.requirement: Net quantity should be declared in standard units.
rules.validation_logic: PASS if net quantity detected; FAIL/NOT_DETECTED otherwise.
rules.fail_message: Net quantity declaration was not detected.
rules.fail_recommendation: Declare/capture net quantity clearly (e.g., Net Qty: 500 g / 1 L).
rules.warning_message: Net quantity text may be incomplete or unit unclear.
rules.warning_recommendation: Confirm quantity value and unit of measurement.

rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
rules.requirement: Name and address of manufacturer, packer or importer should be present (as applicable).
rules.validation_logic: PASS if any of manufacturer/packer/importer detected; FAIL/NOT_DETECTED if none.
rules.fail_message: Manufacturer / packer / importer information was not detected.
rules.fail_recommendation: Ensure manufacturer, packer or importer name/address is visible on the label image.
rules.warning_recommendation: Verify full legal name and address details manually.

rules.name: Manufacturing / Packing / Import Information
rules.requirement: Month and year of manufacture, packing or import should be declared where applicable.
rules.validation_logic: PASS if date/month-year information detected; FAIL/NOT_DETECTED otherwise.
rules.fail_message: Manufacturing / packing / import information was not detected.
rules.fail_recommendation: Ensure month & year of manufacture/packing/import is printed and captured clearly.

rules.name: Consumer Care Information
rules.requirement: Consumer care details should be available for complaints.
rules.validation_logic: PASS if phone/email/care text detected; FAIL/NOT_DETECTED otherwise.
rules.fail_message: Consumer care information was not detected.
rules.fail_recommendation: Provide/capture consumer care phone, email or address clearly.
rules.warning_recommendation: Verify that a working contact channel is printed clearly.

rules.name: Country of Origin
rules.requirement: Country of origin should be declared where applicable (especially imported goods).
rules.validation_logic: PASS if detected; NOT_APPLICABLE/WARNING if missing (not automatically illegal).
rules.fail_message: Country of origin was not detected.
rules.fail_recommendation: If the commodity is imported, declare country of origin clearly.
rules.warning_message: Country of origin not clearly identified; verify if applicable for this package.
rules.warning_recommendation: Confirm whether country-of-origin declaration applies. Do not assume non-compliance solely from absence.

rules.name: Readability Screening
rules.requirement: Label text should be reasonably readable for automated screening (heuristic only).
rules.validation_logic: Uses OCR box height/contrast/confidence. Never claims legal font-size compliance without calibration.
rules.fail_message: Label text appears largely unreadable for automated extraction.
rules.fail_recommendation: Recapture image with better lighting, focus and resolution.
rules.warning_recommendation: Physically verify label readability. Pixel height is not statutory font size.
